This expectation of ongoing policy restraint implies higher interest rates and discount rates, which typically negatively impacts growth-oriented technology stocks that form a significant part of the NASDAQ Composite.

While the Fed was exploring digital currency (art_finance_20220120_002_a28a7ada) and leadership changes were occurring (art_finance_20220525_003_496195a5), the dominant narrative from the available evidence points towards a focus on combating inflation.
